title: 99 Bottles & Cocktails
venue_description:
99 Bottles & Cocktails

99 Bottles & Cocktails is a lively bar and nightspot on Katella Avenue in Anaheim. It is a popular Orange County hangout for drinks happy hour dancing and live music and on Sunday evenings it hosts a pro blues jam.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The bar is social and energetic with a mix of neighborhood regulars and music fans. Sunday Funday events have long been part of the weekly lineup.

Sunday Pro Blues Jam

The 99 Bottles Pro Blues Jam runs on Sundays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Experienced blues players sit in and trade songs and solos with a strong house groove. The event is listed as all ages which makes it a great chance for young players to learn from seasoned musicians.

  • When: Sundays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Style: Blues
  • Ages: All ages

More at 99 Bottles & Cocktails

99 Bottles also offers happy hour specials DJ and dance nights and weekend parties.

Good to Know

99 Bottles & Cocktails is at 8901 Katella Avenue in Anaheim California 92804. Follow the bar on Facebook for the latest schedule.

title: Albion Garden
venue_description:
Albion Garden

Albion Garden is a concept store on Venice's famous Abbot Kinney Boulevard that blends Japanese beauty rituals with California style. It combines a skincare shop face spa and cafe and hosts community events built around connection and creativity including an all arts open mic.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The garden setting is calm mindful and welcoming. The cafe serves unique drinks and bites daily from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM and the store is cashless.

All Arts Open Mic

The Albion Garden All Arts Open Mic runs on the fourth Saturday and Sunday of the month with sign-ups at 12:30 PM. Musicians poets and artists of every kind are welcome to share their work in a relaxed daytime setting on one of LA's most creative streets.

  • When: Fourth Saturdays and Sundays
  • Sign Up: In person from 12:30 PM
  • Format: All arts

Good to Know

Albion Garden is at 1043 Abbot Kinney Boulevard in Venice California 90291. Visit albiongarden.com for hours and community events.

title: All American BBQ
venue_description:
All American BBQ

All American BBQ is a West Hills barbecue joint known for old-school smoked ribs tri-tip and a mesquite fire pit. It has been voted the best ribs and tri-tip in the Valley and it hosts a monthly Sunday open mic.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The restaurant is cozy and friendly with a bar and a relaxed neighborhood crowd that loves good food and live music.

First Sunday Open Mic

The All American BBQ Open Mic runs on the first Sunday of each month from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Each performer gets two songs. It is a laid-back showcase for San Fernando Valley singers and players.

  • When: First Sundays from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM
  • Format: Two songs each

More at All American BBQ

The menu features smoked rib tips beef ribs baby back ribs tri-tip combos and cheesesteaks.

Good to Know

All American BBQ is at 6719 Platt Avenue in West Hills California 91307. Call (818) 363-6500 or visit allamerbbq.com.

title: American Legion Post 507
venue_description:
American Legion Post 507

American Legion Post 507 sits at Spruce and 11th Street in downtown Newhall in the Santa Clarita Valley. Its hall known as Club 507 is home base for the Santa Clarita Valley Blues Society which hosts blues jams concerts and swing dances there.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Club 507 is friendly and down to earth with a big dance floor. Many events include a free dance lesson before the band.

Second Sunday Blues Jam

The Blues Jam at Club 507 runs on the second Sunday of each month from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Local blues players sit in with the band and dancers fill the floor.

  • When: Second Sundays from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM
  • Presented by: Santa Clarita Valley Blues Society
  • Style: Blues

More at American Legion Post 507

The SCV Blues Society books blues and swing bands on other Sundays and holds an annual Battle of the Bands. The 2026 event is October 11 and the winner earns a trip to the International Blues Challenge in Memphis.

Good to Know

American Legion Post 507 is at 24527 Spruce Street in Newhall California 91321. Visit scvblues.org for the calendar.

title: Camel's Bar and Grill
venue_description:
Camel's Bar and Grill

Camel's Bar and Grill long known as Camel's Breath Inn is a full-service neighborhood bar in San Diego's Mission Valley. It has a full kitchen games a dog-friendly patio and a busy live music calendar that makes it a favorite for blues fans.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Camel's is casual and welcoming with darts cornhole and a loyal local crowd.

Second Sunday Blues Jam

The Second Sunday Blues Jam runs from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM on the second Sunday of each month. A full backline is provided so players can walk in and plug in. Start times can vary so call ahead.

  • When: Second Sundays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
  • Gear: Full backline
  • Style: Blues and R&B

More at Camel's Bar and Grill

Camel's hosts blues jams on Tuesdays karaoke on Thursdays and Saturdays live bands on Saturday afternoons and R&B nights. Happy hour runs weekdays 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM and weekend breakfast is served 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

Good to Know

Camel's Bar and Grill is at 10330 Friars Road Suite 106 in San Diego California 92120. Call (619) 281-1722 or visit camelsbarandgrill.com.
location: 10330 Friars Rd Ste 106, San Diego, CA 92120

title: Coomber Craft Wines
venue_description:
Coomber Craft Wines

Coomber Craft Wines is a small-batch winery tasting room and event venue on Mission Avenue in downtown Oceanside. The team believes having fun should be part of drinking great wine and live music is a regular part of the experience.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The tasting room is relaxed and social a short walk from the Oceanside beach and pier.

Sunday Open Mic

The Coomber Craft Wines Open Mic runs on Sundays with sign-ups at 5:30 PM and music from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM. It is a friendly spot for singer-songwriters and acoustic players to share songs over a glass of wine.

  • When: Sundays from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 5:30 PM

More at Coomber Craft Wines

Coomber hosts live music and events through the week and offers a wine club with member events.

Good to Know

Coomber Craft Wines is at 611 Mission Avenue in Oceanside California 92054. Call (760) 231-8022 or visit coomberwines.com.

title: The Desert Room
venue_description:
The Desert Room

The Desert Room is a neighborhood bar on West Gardena Boulevard in Gardena. Locals describe it as a good old neighborhood bar with a twist thanks to cheap drinks friendly bartenders free parking free popcorn and plenty of live blues.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Easygoing and unpretentious with a crowd that loves live music.

Sunday Open Blues Jam

The Desert Room Open Blues Jam runs on Sundays from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Blues players sit in with the house band and the room fills with musicians and fans.

  • When: Sundays from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM
  • Style: Blues

More at The Desert Room

The Desert Room hosts bands on Sundays and Tuesdays including monthly blues nights.

Good to Know

The Desert Room is at 1006 West Gardena Boulevard in Gardena California 90247.

title: Hideaway Bar and Grill
venue_description:
Hideaway Bar and Grill

Hideaway Bar and Grill is a country-style bar and grill tucked into Kagel Canyon above Sylmar at the northern edge of the San Fernando Valley. It is a rustic getaway with food drinks karaoke and live music.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Hideaway feels like a mountain roadhouse with a friendly local crowd.

Sunday Jam

The Hideaway Sunday Jam runs from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Local players gather for an afternoon of music in a laid-back canyon setting.

  • When: Sundays from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM

More at Hideaway Bar and Grill

The Hideaway also hosts karaoke nights.

Good to Know

Hideaway Bar and Grill is at 12122 Kagel Canyon Road in Sylmar California 91342.

title: Folk Music Center
venue_description:
Folk Music Center

The Folk Music Center and Museum on Yale Avenue in the Claremont Village has been a gathering place for acoustic musicians since 1958. It sells and repairs instruments from around the world displays a museum collection of historic instruments and hosts concerts and a monthly open mic.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The center is warm and community minded with walls lined with guitars banjos and world instruments.

Last Sunday Open Mic

The Folk Music Center Open Mic runs on the last Sunday of each month. Doors and sign-ups open at 6:00 PM and there is a small $2 fee. Acoustic performers of all kinds are welcome.

  • When: Last Sundays from 6:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 6:00 PM
  • Cost: $2

More at Folk Music Center

The center hosts concerts by folk and roots artists along with lessons and instrument services.

Good to Know

The Folk Music Center is at 220 Yale Avenue in Claremont California 91711. Call (909) 624-2928 or visit folkmusiccenter.com.

title: Liquid Zoo
venue_description:
Liquid Zoo

Liquid Zoo is a classic dive bar on Sepulveda Boulevard in Van Nuys. It is a longtime San Fernando Valley hangout with cheap drinks late hours and a mixed open mic on Sunday nights.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Zoo is loose fun and unpretentious with a late-night crowd.

Sunday Mixed Open Mic

The Liquid Zoo Mixed Open Mic runs Sundays from 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM. Musicians get two songs and comedians get seven minutes. It is one of the latest-running open mics in the Valley.

  • When: Sundays from 9:00 PM to 1:00 AM
  • Format: Two songs for music or seven minutes for comedy

Good to Know

Liquid Zoo is at 7214 Sepulveda Boulevard in Van Nuys California 91405.

title: MJ's Unique Social Club
venue_description:
MJ's Unique Social Club

MJ's Unique Social Club on West Slauson Avenue in the Hyde Park and Crenshaw area of Los Angeles is a neighborhood club with deep blues and soul roots. Its Sunday Blues Show and Jam is billed by regulars as the best jam in LA.

Atmosphere and Vibe

MJ's is warm soulful and full of great musicians. The back room fills with players and dancers every Sunday night.

MJ's Blues Show and Jam

MJ's Blues Show and Jam runs every Sunday from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM. It opens with a show and then the stage opens to players. The music covers blues R&B funk soul and a little rock and roll.

  • When: Sundays from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM
  • Style: Blues R&B funk and soul

More at MJ's Unique Social Club

MJ's also books blues bands and touring acts on weekend nights.

Good to Know

MJ's Unique Social Club is at 3668 West Slauson Avenue in Los Angeles California 90043. Follow MJ's on Facebook.
location: 3668 W Slauson Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90043

title: Saddle Bar
venue_description:
Saddle Bar

Saddle Bar is a beloved dive bar in Solana Beach on the San Diego coast. The building dates to the 1920s and was the famous Surf and Saddle from 1954 until 2010. Four former regulars bought and renovated it and reopened it as the Saddle Bar in 2012.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The Saddle Bar has a friendly Cheers-like feel for locals tourists and the Del Mar racetrack crowd. It is dog friendly and there is never a cover.

Sunday Open Mic

The Saddle Bar Open Mic runs on Sundays from 9:00 PM to midnight with sign-ups at 8:45 PM. Music comedy and poetry are welcome. The event is 21 and over.

  • When: Sundays from 9:00 PM to Midnight
  • Sign Up: In person from 8:45 PM
  • Ages: 21 and over

More at Saddle Bar

Saddle Bar books DJs live bands and solo acts through the week.

Good to Know

Saddle Bar is at 123 West Plaza Street in Solana Beach California 92075. Call (858) 755-5007 or visit thesaddlebar.com.
location: 123 W Plaza St, Solana Beach, CA 92075

title: Temecula Sports Lounge
venue_description:
Temecula Sports Lounge

Temecula Sports Lounge is a sports bar and nightlife spot on Jefferson Avenue with more than 22 big screens three projectors and a busy music and events calendar.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The lounge is social and high energy with sports on every screen and themed music nights.

Sunday Open Mic Jam

The Temecula Sports Open Mic Jam runs on Sundays from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM with sign-ups at 4:00 PM. Guest DJ Wen helps keep the energy up through the late afternoon and evening.

  • When: Sundays from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM
  • Sign Up: In person from 4:00 PM

More at Temecula Sports Lounge

Other nights include a Thursday singles party First Friday house music and Saturday Urban Cowboy line dancing. Happy hour runs Tuesday through Thursday from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

Good to Know

Temecula Sports Lounge is at 27911 Jefferson Avenue in Temecula California 92590. Call (951) 349-5884 or visit temeculasportslounge.com. Closed Mondays.

title: The New Scotland Yard Pub
venue_description:
The New Scotland Yard Pub

The New Scotland Yard Pub on Sherman Way is a Canoga Park dive bar and music venue open daily from noon to 2:00 AM. It is a true San Fernando Valley local with darts pool live bands and DJ nights.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Unpretentious and community oriented with friendly bartenders and plenty of regulars.

Sunday Mixed Open Mic

The Scotland Yard Mixed Open Mic runs on Sundays from 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM with a full backline so bands and solo players can plug in and play.

  • When: Sundays from 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM
  • Gear: Full backline

More at The New Scotland Yard Pub

The pub books live bands and DJs through the week.

Good to Know

The New Scotland Yard Pub is at 22041 Sherman Way in Canoga Park California 91303. Call (818) 703-9523.

title: Sound Dhaba
venue_description:
Sound Dhaba

Sound Dhaba is an intimate music venue and event space in downtown LA's Arts District. It presents jazz world music and experimental shows along with jams and listening sessions for curious ears.

Atmosphere and Vibe

Sound Dhaba is creative adventurous and welcoming to artists and listeners who love to explore.

Sound Dhaba Open Mic

The Sound Dhaba Open Mic runs on the first and third Sundays of each month from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. It is an afternoon session for musicians of all styles.

  • When: First and third Sundays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM

More at Sound Dhaba

Sound Dhaba hosts ticketed concerts world music jams and listening sessions.

Good to Know

Sound Dhaba is listed at 941 East 2nd Street in Los Angeles. Email sounddhaba@gmail.com or visit the Sound Dhaba website to confirm the location and schedule.

title: VFW Post 2323
venue_description:
VFW Post 2323

VFW Post 2323 known as the All-American Post is a veterans hall on Chatsworth Street in Granada Hills. It supports veterans through honor guard service outreach and community programs and opens its doors to the community for music and events.

Atmosphere and Vibe

The post is friendly and welcoming with a strong sense of camaraderie.

Grandstand Jam

The VFW 2323 Grandstand Jam runs on Sundays from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM. It is an all-ages jam for Valley musicians and a fun way to support local veterans.

  • When: Sundays from 5:30 PM to 8:30 PM
  • Ages: All ages

More at VFW Post 2323

The post hosts live bands community events and Toys for Tots and offers hall rentals.

Good to Know

VFW Post 2323 is at 17522 Chatsworth Street in Granada Hills California 91344. Call (818) 366-7799 or visit vfwpost2323.org.
